ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with a high-contrast ratio of approximately 15:85 white-to-black across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark base pigmentation with distinct, contiguous high-contrast white circular rings (annular shapes) scattered across both lobes. A concentration of these rings is visible in the lower-central quadrant of the left lobe, while the right lobe contains more diffused, light-grey mottled patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a visible angle of approximately 60 degrees separating the two primary lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Notable irregular peaks and valleys, particularly dense on the upper-distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary trailing edge, terminating in sharply tapered, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular rings and clusters of white annular marks distributed across the fluke, most concentrated on the medial-lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible calcified barnacle colonies attached to the extreme distal tips and along segments of the trailing edge on both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific annular (ring-shaped) morphology of the scars, appearing as 'O' shapes with dark centers rather than solid white mottling.
